messages:
Eli K: Heads-up: Prospect 'OrchardSys' wants SOC2 excerpt, ISO cert snippet, and a signed pen-test authorization. Their vendor will scan staging and may push to a short dedicated pool. They also asked for ephemeral creds (S3 presign + short-lived SSH). Who owns the attestation and any cost estimates?

Sonia P: We can provide redacted SOC2 + ISO27001 excerpt + control mapping. Legal signs pen-test authorisations; security provides scope. We never give persistent host creds or raw host logs.

Marco T: Ops note: presigned S3 upload + timeboxed SSH via jumpbox (one-time JWT) is standard. If they need a warmed dedicated pool for the scan, that's a reserved burst and billed. VPN into staging adds setup time.

Riley B: For signatory, legal can sign standard attestation. If they request changes to indemnity or broadened liability, escalate. Also confirm whether tests target shared infra or a single-tenant pool.

Eli K: Quick pricing ask: can we ballpark an 8h window for 4x A100 + ops support? Buyer needs an idea before committing their vendor.

Marco T: Rough estimate: 8h 4x A100 ~= 0.4x daily Dedicated rate => approx $1.8k infra + ~$400 ops = ~$2.2k total. If they want 24h add ~2x. Exact quote from capacity team needed.

Sonia P: Action items: 1) Marco to create presigned upload. 2) Eli to request vendor scope + IPs into the presign link. 3) Riley to prepare signature-ready attestation. 4) Marco to confirm final pricing after capacity check.

Ops Bot: Pre-signed upload created: https://uploads.redwood-inference.com/presign/orchard-1768005432 (expires in 48 hours). Please upload vendor scope and redlines under /orchard/vendor-scope/.

Eli K: Uploaded vendor scope + vendor insurance + preliminary IP list. Also noted vendor will request VPN if IP allowlist insufficient.

Marco T: Noted. VPN instead of IP allowlist adds ~1 business day ops and a setup fee. Flagging to sales so buyer knows.

Riley B: Draft attestation line I'll include: "Redwood Inference will limit testing to the agreed scope and timeframe; Redwood Inference is not responsible for findings outside that agreed scope." I'll sign once legal approves final redlines.

Sonia P: I'll tell the customer: we can sign standard attestation within 2 business days after scope, presigned upload is ready, and estimated one-time ops charge ~ $2.2k for the 8h 4x A100 burst (subject to final capacity confirmation). Tag me on any redlines.

Eli K: Great, passing to Orchardsys now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
